run_scene_mapping: run the scene mapping routine to explore rooms and save RGBD+pose trajectories for Concept-Graph map creation
run_planner_function: run the planner function that loads config, registers sensors and actions, and executes room-by-room exploration
setup_config_with_overrides: setup the configuration with dataset, sensor, LLM, trajectory, and episode overrides for scene mapping
register_sensors_and_actions: register dynamic habitat sensors and custom actions for the agent environment interface
create_evaluation_runner: create a CentralizedEvaluationRunner to orchestrate agent planning and store video frames for trajectory visualization
